analysis:
Examined both files' metadata, patches and supplied BASE/HEAD source against the canonical index and selected T-041 detail. SandboxInstaller.swift:107-137 adds textual disk-capability detection and repeated --disk/value argument pairs for planning and installation. HTTPS-only downloads, size limits and owner-only staging remain unchanged. Argument construction does not interpolate disk paths into shell source; downstream parsing remains an external contract.
SandboxSetupCommand.swift's changed HEAD ranges 156-186 and 291-367 introduce explicit disk checks, interactive external-drive selection and consent before invoking an ownership-enabling helper. Lines 419-446 refuse a failed installer plan when disks were requested; lines 480-485 reject explicit disks for scripts not naming --disk. Existing non-root execution and running-job refusal advice are retained. No supported security regression is established in these units.
Relevant boundaries/assets are TB-013, T-061 and A-019 (installer/add-on execution as owner), plus A-018/T-059 (serving availability). T-041's encrypted inference-cache storage guarantees must not be assumed to protect sandbox VM images or jobs; these changes do not modify that cache. No direct change to serving authorization, attestation, request encryption or billing is visible.
Integration must examine SandboxWorkDisk.absolutePath, volume/check/problem/candidates and enableOwnership implementations, particularly privileged executable/argument selection and path handling. Also verify the add-on installer contract for work-disk permissions, mount replacement/disconnection, migration and refusal while jobs run. Those implementations are not supplied here, so their absence is not a finding. Determine whether TB-013/A-019 coverage needs extension for the new sudo ownership operation and external VM/job storage; only the compact boundary definition was supplied.
